skill.name: background-removal
skill.description: Remove image backgrounds with Verging AI and return transparent PNG files from local images or remote image URLs.
skill.summary: Remove backgrounds from JPG, PNG, and WebP images through the Verging AI API.
skill.author: verging.ai

security_audit.summary: Most static shell backtick alerts are Markdown fences or inline examples, but the skill genuinely performs curl-based network calls, uses VERGING_API_KEY, writes predictable files under /tmp, and uploads images to verging.ai. I found no prompt injection language. The remaining concerns are credential handling, arbitrary remote URL fetching, third-party image upload privacy, and predictable temporary paths.

remediation.suggestion: Restrict downloads to HTTPS, block private and metadata IP ranges, and request confirmation before fetching remote images.
Read VERGING_API_KEY only when needed, never log Authorization headers, and avoid secret-like placeholder values in examples.
Tell users that images are sent to Verging AI and may be uploaded to R2, and add guidance for sensitive images.
Use unique per-run temp files with restricted permissions, and remove downloaded images after each run.
Document safe quoting for paths and URLs, and prevent arbitrary prompt text from becoming shell arguments.

static_findings.snippet: - **No separate upload step needed** — create-job handles R2 upload internally when you provide `ima
- **`image` must be a file upload (`@path`)** — NOT a URL string
Get your API key: https://verging.ai → Login → Avatar → API Keys

semantic_findings.title: Unvalidated Remote URL Fetch
semantic_findings.description: The skill accepts image URLs and instructs curl -L to download the supplied URL before validation. Without scheme, host, and private-network checks, prompt-controlled input could cause unintended outbound requests from the agent environment.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The command format allows URLs, and the execution flow explicitly downloads an arbitrary URL with curl. The file gives no allowlist, scheme restriction, or private IP filtering guidance.

semantic_findings.title: Third-Party Image Upload Privacy Risk
semantic_findings.description: The skill uploads user images to the Verging AI API and notes that create-job handles R2 upload internally. Sensitive images may leave the local environment, and the skill does not describe retention, consent, or data handling limits.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The API flow directly posts the image file and states that server-side R2 upload is handled internally. This is disclosed functionality, but privacy impact is real and not covered by the static categories alone.

content.user_title: Remove Image Backgrounds with Verging AI
content.value_statement: Background cleanup for products, profiles, and creative assets can take repeated manual editing. This skill sends images to Verging AI and returns transparent PNG results.
actual_capabilities: Removes backgrounds from JPG, PNG, and WebP images through the Verging AI API.
Accepts local image paths or remote image URLs as the input source.
Uses VERGING_API_KEY for authenticated credit checks and job creation.
Creates a background-removal job and polls until the job completes or fails.
Returns a result URL and can download the transparent PNG output when requested.
limitations: Requires a Verging AI API key, available credits, curl, and network access.
Uploads input images to an external service for processing.
Supports only JPG, PNG, and WebP images up to 10 MB.
Processes one image per command and depends on the remote service status.

use_cases.title: Prepare Product Photos
use_cases.description: Create transparent product images for catalog pages, ads, and marketplace listings.

use_cases.title: Create Design Cutouts
use_cases.description: Remove busy backgrounds before placing people, objects, or assets into design compositions.

use_cases.title: Automate Asset Cleanup
use_cases.description: Run background removal inside agent workflows that prepare images for documentation or campaigns.

prompt_templates.title: Remove a Local Background
prompt_templates.prompt: Remove the background from ./photo.jpg and show me the transparent PNG result link.

prompt_templates.title: Save the Transparent Output
prompt_templates.prompt: Remove the background from ./headshot.png and save the transparent PNG as ./headshot-transparent.png.

prompt_templates.title: Process a Remote Image
prompt_templates.prompt: Remove the background from https://example.com/photo.png and download the transparent PNG to the current folder.

prompt_templates.title: Validate and Run
prompt_templates.prompt: Check my Verging AI credits, confirm ./product.webp is under 10 MB, then remove its background and save the result.

output_examples.input: A local product photo named product.jpg with a cluttered table behind the item.
output_examples.output: The skill reports a completed job, provides a transparent PNG result link, and saves the file when download is requested.

output_examples.input: A remote portrait image URL that should become a profile cutout.
output_examples.output: The skill downloads the source image, submits it to Verging AI, and returns the final transparent PNG link.

best_practices: Use trusted image sources and review remote URLs before downloading them.
Keep VERGING_API_KEY in the environment and avoid sharing command logs that include headers.
Use explicit output paths and delete temporary files after processing sensitive images.
anti_patterns: Do not process confidential images without approval to send them to an external service.
Do not pass untrusted remote URLs without checking the destination first.
Do not reuse downloaded temporary files as if they were verified originals.

faq.question: Does this skill need an API key?
faq.answer: Yes. It uses VERGING_API_KEY to authenticate with the Verging AI API.

faq.question: Does the background removal run locally?
faq.answer: No. The skill uploads images to Verging AI and receives a transparent PNG result.

faq.question: Which image formats are supported?
faq.answer: It supports JPG, PNG, and WebP images up to 10 MB.

faq.question: How many credits does one image use?
faq.answer: The skill documentation states that each image costs one credit.

faq.question: Can it process a remote image URL?
faq.answer: Yes. It can download a remote image first, but users should verify the URL before processing.

faq.question: Can it save the transparent PNG file?
faq.answer: Yes. Use an output path or download option to save the generated transparent PNG.
